newsitem.title: CHINA: China's Huaneng in 30 bln yuan power plant project.
newsitem.headline: China's Huaneng in 30 bln yuan power plant project.

text.p: Huaneng Group has signed an agreement to build a 30 billion yuan ($3.6 billion) power plant in the coal-rich province of Shaanxi, the China News Service said on Wednesday.

Huaneng Group, which includes New York-listed Huaneng Power International, will join with the China Northwest Power Group and an investment arm of the Shaanxi Provincial Power Co to jointly build the 3,000-megawatt facility at Fugu in northern Shaanxi.
The power plant would be built in three stages but there were no details of the construction schedule. The report also did not say how large a stake in the project each of the members would take.
